name: Posco Future M Co., Ltd.
summary: Posco Future M Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the refractory, industrial furnaces, and lime businesses in South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, China, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Refractories, Burned Lime/Carbon Materials, and Energy Materials segments. The company manufactures and sells various shaped refractories, such as magnesia carbon and magnesia chrome; unshaped refractories comprising castables, stamp materials, and tundish coating materials; magnesia clinkers; and functional refractories.
